visuals.label: Figure 1
visuals.caption: Overview of continuous action-function learning and deployment. Training Stage A learns shared spatiotemporal priors from typed trajectories across embodiments and temporal sampling grids. Training Stage B connects observation-conditioned latent prediction to the learned function space using latent and physical reconstruction supervision. At inference, current multimodal observations and visual features condition latent prediction; the function decoder combines the predicted latent with physical query times and observed context to produce embodiment-specific control commands.

visuals.label: Figure 2
visuals.caption: An action interval and its sampling grid are different objects. Schematic of a continuous scalar position reference. The first two panels query the same function over the same physical duration with different grids. The third changes the duration: the geometric progression is preserved, but its velocity and acceleration change. A reusable function representation must retain physical timing while allowing the execution grid to vary.
